name: dwg-viewer-vscode
description: Open-source, local-first 2D CAD viewer compatible with the DWG file format, with Korean CAD fonts, XREFs, measurements, text search, layouts, and PNG/PDF export

commands.title: 2D CAD Viewer: SHX 글꼴 폴더 추가
2D CAD Viewer: 워크스페이스 도면 문자 검색
2D CAD Viewer: 도면 문자 검색 다시 실행
2D CAD Viewer: 도면 문자 검색 정규식 사용

dwgViewer.libredwgAdapterPath.description: Optional absolute path used only as an offline fallback when the version-matched LibreDWG converter cannot be installed automatically.

dwgViewer.progressivePreview.description: Show an overview while full conversion continues. This improves first-frame latency but substantially increases concurrent memory.

enumDescriptions: Keep generated Scene Caches only while the drawing or workspace search is using them, then delete them.
Keep validated Scene Caches for faster subsequent opens. This can use several times the source DWG size on local disk.
dwgViewer.sceneCacheMode.description: Choose whether generated drawing caches are retained between sessions. Changing this setting affects newly opened drawings.

dwgViewer.sceneCacheMaximumSizeGiB.description: Maximum local disk space in GiB for persistent drawing caches. Oldest closed drawings are removed first; session mode does not retain them.

enumDescriptions: Dynamically reduce backing pixels on high-DPI and interactive frames, then restore bounded detail when interaction stops.
Keep up to 2 device pixels per CSS pixel without a display pixel budget.
Prefer lower backing resolution for the smallest GPU fill and overlay cost.
dwgViewer.renderResolution.description: Control the drawing surface resolution used by WebGL and canvas overlays. Raster exports keep their requested output size.

enumDescriptions: Redraw low-resolution geometry on every interaction frame so newly exposed areas remain visible. This uses the most GPU and CPU time.
Move the completed frame immediately and refresh low-resolution geometry periodically. This is the recommended balance of responsiveness and coverage.
Move only the completed frame until interaction stops. This minimizes rendering work, but newly exposed areas can remain blank temporarily.
dwgViewer.interactionRendering.description: Choose how the viewer redraws while panning or zooming. Conversion and export performance are unaffected.

enumDescriptions: Zoom with every unmodified vertical scroll, including a detented wheel, smooth-scrolling wheel, or Magic Mouse. This is the default.
Pan with every unmodified scroll regardless of speed. Trackpad pinch remains zoom.
dwgViewer.scrollInputMode.description: Choose deterministic scroll behavior. Input hardware is not detected automatically because smooth mouse and trackpad events are indistinguishable.

dwgViewer.mouseWheelZoomSensitivity.description: Adjust mouse-wheel zoom distance. 1.0 is the standard response; higher values zoom farther per wheel step.

dwgViewer.trackpadPinchZoomSensitivity.description: Adjust trackpad pinch zoom distance. 1.0 matches the original response; the faster 1.5 default zooms 50% farther for the same gesture.

enumDescriptions: Expand all top toolbar icons and names together when the ellipsis is hovered, focused, or opened.
Reveal icon-only actions when the ellipsis is hovered, focused, or opened.
dwgViewer.topToolbarLabels.description: Choose whether the top-right drawing toolbar shows names when it expands.

enumDescriptions: Expand the entire left review toolbar and show every tool name when the shelf is hovered or focused.
Keep the left review toolbar icon-only. Tool names remain available as tooltips.
dwgViewer.leftToolbarLabels.description: Choose whether the left drawing toolbar expands to show tool names.

dwgViewer.shxFontDirectories.description: Absolute folders searched non-recursively for SHX and BigFont files after the first drawing frame.

dwgViewer.shxFontMappings.description: Map a DWG-requested SHX name to a replacement filename in the configured folders or to an absolute SHX file path.

dwgViewer.shxBigFontEncodings.description: Map a DWG-requested BigFont name to auto glyph probing, strict EUC-KR, Windows CP949/UHC, or Johab CP1361 codes.

dwgViewer.xrefSearchDirectories.description: Absolute folders searched recursively and within fixed limits when a DWG external reference is not found at its stored path.

dwgViewer.imageSearchDirectories.description: Absolute folders searched recursively and within fixed limits when a JPG or PNG drawing image is not found at its stored path.

dwgViewer.textSearchMaximumFiles.description: Maximum number of workspace DWG files inspected by one text search.

dwgViewer.textSearchMaximumResults.description: Maximum number of DWG text search results retained in the Explorer view.

dwgViewer.textSearchMatchCase.description: Match letter case in workspace DWG text search.

dwgViewer.textSearchWholeWord.description: Match whole words only in workspace DWG text search.

dwgViewer.textSearchUseRegularExpression.description: Use a bounded JavaScript regular expression by default in workspace DWG text search. The Explorer view toggle is retained per workspace.

scripts.build: pnpm run build:webview && pnpm run compile && pnpm run prepare:package
scripts.test: pnpm run compile && node --test dist/test/*.test.js && pnpm run test:qualification
scripts.check: pnpm run build && node --test dist/test/*.test.js && pnpm run test:qualification
